- `onStop: ()=>void` (optional). Called by the stop action while streaming. Without it the stop action is unavailable.
- `status: PromptInputStatus` (optional; default "idle"). Idle shows the send action; streaming turns the same button node into a stop action and holds Enter.
- `label: string` (optional). Accessible textarea name; defaults to the scoped promptInput message.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Visible hint inside the empty textarea. It does not replace the accessible label.
- `name: string` (optional). Native textarea name for FormData.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables the textarea and action natively.
- `maxRows: number` (optional; default 8). Positive integer row count where growth stops and the textarea scrolls.
- `leading: JSX.Element` (optional). Toolbar content before the action area, such as an attachment button.
- `trailing: JSX.Element` (optional). Toolbar content placed immediately before the send/stop action.
- `submitLabel: string` (optional). Send action accessible name; defaults to the scoped sendMessage message.
- `stopLabel: string` (optional). Stop action accessible name; defaults to the scoped stopResponse message.
- `textareaRef: (element:HTMLTextAreaElement)=>void` (optional). Native textarea reference for focus management.

Accessibility role: form containing a multiline textbox and a send/stop button
Keyboard: Enter submits, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, Enter confirming an IME candidate does not submit, Tab moves to toolbar actions, Enter or Space activates send/stop
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-text-body-leading`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-surface-radius`

Do:
- Keep the draft editable while a response streams; only submission waits.
- Return focus decisions to the app; the action keeps focus through send/stop changes.

Do not:
- Do not submit on Enter during IME composition.
- Do not clear a controlled draft before the app accepts the submission.

Example, Chat composer:
```tsx
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";
const [status, setStatus] = createSignal<"idle" | "streaming">("idle");
<PromptInput placeholder="Ask anything" status={status()} onSubmit={() => setStatus("streaming")} onStop={() => setStatus("idle")} />
```

Example, Attachment slot:
```tsx
<PromptInput onSubmit={() => {}} leading={<Button size="sm">Attach</Button>} />
```

### Prose

Long-form reading typography for rendered Markdown, help articles, changelogs, and legal text. Styles native descendants (headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, images) with a readable measure.

Category: typography

Props:

Accessibility role: none; descendants keep native semantics
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-text-body-size`, `--sheen-text-body-leading`, `--sheen-text-h1-size`, `--sheen-text-h2-size`, `--sheen-text-h3-size`, `--sheen-color-accent-fg`, `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-font-mono`

Do:
- Sanitize untrusted HTML before rendering it inside Prose.
- Keep one Prose region per article so the measure stays readable.

Do not:
- Do not wrap application chrome, forms, or tables of records in Prose; use components with their own styling.

Example, Rendered article:
```tsx
<Prose>
  <h2>Rotate an API key</h2>
  <p>Create the new key before revoking the old one.</p>
  <ol><li>Open <strong>Settings → API keys</strong>.</li><li>Choose <em>Rotate</em>.</li></ol>
</Prose>
```

### RadioGroup

A named native group of mutually exclusive choices.

Category: forms

Props:
- `id: string` (optional). Root fieldset ID used to derive stable nested IDs.
- `ref: HTMLFieldSetElement|((element:HTMLFieldSetElement)=>void)` (optional). Native root fieldset reference.
- `name: string` (required). Required nonempty native name; use a distinct name per group within its owning form.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible group legend.
- `options: readonly CheckboxOption[]` (required). Options with unique nonempty values, labels, optional descriptions and disabled flags.
- `value: string|null` (optional). App-owned selection; null explicitly selects nothing.
- `defaultValue: string|null` (optional). Captured uncontrolled selection restored on uncanceled form reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:string|null)=>void` (optional). Receives requested selection changes, including null when reset clears an uncontrolled group.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting instructions associated with the group and its inputs.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated group error and invalid state without automatic focus or announcements.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Rejects changes while retaining focus and submitted values.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires one selection for native form validation.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "vertical"). Visual arrangement and ARIA orientation.

Accessibility role: radiogroup
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Space, Arrow keys
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`

Do:
- Use a stable legend and unique native group name.

Do not:
- Do not use radios for independent on/off choices or toolbar toggle groups.

Example, Refresh cadence:
```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Refresh cadence" name="cadence" options={[{ value: "live", label: "Live" }, { value: "manual", label: "Manual" }]} defaultValue="live" />
```

### RangeSlider

A two-thumb slider with an ordered tuple contract, minimum separation, and distinct accessible thumb names.

Category: forms

Props:
- `value: readonly [number,number]` (optional). Controlled increasing pair within the configured range.
- `defaultValue: readonly [number,number]` (optional). Initial uncontrolled pair; defaults to min and max.
- `onValueChange: (value:readonly [number,number])=>void` (optional). Receives exactly two ordered values during interaction.
- `onValueChangeEnd: (value:readonly [number,number])=>void` (optional). Receives exactly two ordered values at interaction end.
- `minStepsBetweenThumbs: number` (optional; default 0). Nonnegative integer count of required steps between thumbs.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible group label.
- `min: number` (optional; default 0). Finite inclusive lower bound.
- `max: number` (optional; default 100). Finite inclusive upper bound.
- `step: number` (optional; default 1). Positive finite increment.
- `formatOptions: Intl.NumberFormatOptions` (optional). Intl number options evaluated with the effective scoped locale.
- `name: string` (optional). Shared native form name for the two range inputs.
- `form: string` (optional). ID of a form outside the component ancestry.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with both thumbs.
- `error: string` (optional). Validation text that marks the slider invalid.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables pointer, keyboard, and form interaction.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents changes while retaining focus.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks both native range inputs required.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal or vertical physical orientation.
- `inverted: boolean` (optional; default false). Reverses the physical direction without changing tuple order.

Accessibility role: slider
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Give both bounds one clear group label; Sheen supplies distinct minimum and maximum thumb names.

Do not:
- Do not use an unordered pair or silently sort invalid app state.

Example, Latency window:
```tsx
<RangeSlider label="Latency window" defaultValue={[20, 80]} min={0} max={100} minStepsBetweenThumbs={5} />
```

### Resizable

Hydration-stable panes with pointer, keyboard and persisted sizing.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). Ordered panels and handles.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal side-by-side or vertical stacked panels.
- `sizes: readonly number[]` (optional). Controlled panel fractions summing to one.
- `defaultSizes: readonly number[]` (optional). Deterministic initial panel fractions summing to one.
- `onSizesChange: (sizes:readonly number[])=>void` (optional). Reports validated immutable panel fractions.
- `keyboardStep: number` (optional; default 0.05). Fraction moved by a separator arrow-key action.
- `persistence: ResizablePersistence` (optional). App-owned server-known initial sizes, save function, and explicit error handler.

Accessibility role: group containing adjustable separators
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Pass the same persisted initialSizes on the server and client.

Do not:
- Do not read localStorage on mount and visibly replace server geometry.

Example, Inspector split:
```tsx
<Resizable defaultSizes={[0.35, 0.65]}><ResizablePanel index={0}>Files</ResizablePanel><ResizableHandle index={0} label="Resize files and preview" /><ResizablePanel index={1}>Preview</ResizablePanel></Resizable>
```

### ResizableHandle

Labeled pointer and keyboard separator between panels.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name describing both adjacent panels.
- `index: number` (required). Index of the preceding panel.

Accessibility role: separator
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Name both adjacent regions in the label.

Do not:
- Do not remove the separator from the tab order.

Example, Editor separator:
```tsx
<Resizable><ResizablePanel index={0}>Source</ResizablePanel><ResizableHandle index={0} label="Resize source and result" /><ResizablePanel index={1}>Result</ResizablePanel></Resizable>
```

### ResizablePanel

Defines a bounded, optionally collapsible pane inside Resizable.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `children: JSX.Element` (required). Retained panel content.
- `index: number` (required). Stable zero-based index into the root initial-size snapshot.
- `panelId: string` (optional). Stable ID used by the separator relationship.
- `initialSize: number` (optional). Panel-specific initial fraction, overriding the root entry.
- `minSize: number` (optional). Minimum fraction allowed during resize.
- `maxSize: number` (optional). Maximum fraction allowed during resize.
- `collapsible: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows the panel to collapse past its threshold.
- `collapsedSize: number` (optional; default 0). Fraction retained while collapsed.
- `collapseThreshold: number` (optional; default 0.05). Required overdrag fraction before collapse.
- `onResize: (size:number)=>void` (optional). Reports current panel fraction.
- `onCollapse: (size:number)=>void` (optional). Reports the final collapsed fraction.
- `onExpand: (size:number)=>void` (optional). Reports the restored expanded fraction.

Accessibility role: region controlled by adjacent separator
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Keep important controls reachable at the minimum size.

Do not:
- Do not use unstable panel IDs across refreshes.

Example, Bounded pane:
```tsx
<Resizable><ResizablePanel index={0} minSize={0.2}>Files</ResizablePanel><ResizableHandle index={0} label="Resize files and preview" /><ResizablePanel index={1}>Preview</ResizablePanel></Resizable>
```

### Row

Logical horizontal flow, wrapping by default.

Category: layout

Props:
- `wrap: boolean` (optional; default true). Wrap onto additional lines when inline space is exhausted.
- `gap: Spacing` (optional; default "md"). Role-based spacing that follows the active density.
- `align: Alignment` (optional; default "center"). Cross-axis alignment without changing DOM or keyboard order.
- `justify: Justification` (optional; default "start"). Main-axis distribution without reversing content order.

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not use layout wrappers to invent inaccessible keyboard order.

Example, Row composition:
```tsx
<Row><Button>Save</Button><Button>Cancel</Button></Row>
```

### ScrollArea

A named, keyboard-accessible native scrolling viewport that retains content and scroll ownership.

Category: layout

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name distinguishing this scrolling region.
- `orientation: "vertical"|"horizontal"|"both"` (optional; default "vertical"). Scrollable axes. The parent must constrain their dimensions.

Accessibility role: region
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg-subtle`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Constrain the viewport through its grid/flex parent or explicit size.
- Use its native ref for app-owned per-pane restoration.

Do not:
- Do not remount the viewport to refresh its content.
- Do not treat this as virtualization or automatic data loading.

Example, Constrained activity pane:
```tsx
<ScrollArea label="Activity" style={{ height: "12rem" }}><p>Activity content</p></ScrollArea>
```

### SearchInput

Labeled search input with a localized clear action.

Category: forms

Props:
- `value: string` (optional). Controlled query. When supplied, the parent must accept changes through onValueChange. An active IME draft remains locally visible until composition ends.
- `defaultValue: string` (optional). Initial uncontrolled query and native form-reset target, ignored when value is supplied.
- `onValueChange: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Receives input and clear edits synchronously, including composition input, and changed uncontrolled values after an uncanceled form reset. No fetching or debounce is performed.
- `clearLabel: string` (optional). Override the localized clear-search action label.
- `shortcut: ShortcutAction` (optional). Optional typed shortcut registration that focuses the input when a ShortcutProvider is present.
- `description: string` (optional). Associated search instructions.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `error: string` (optional). App-owned validation message.

Accessibility role: searchbox plus a native clear button
Keyboard: Native text editing, Tab to clear action, Enter or Space clears and restores input focus
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-control-h-md`

Do:
- Own requests, debounce, composition-aware search scheduling, and stale-result handling in the app.
- Keep existing results visible during query refresh. Use native onInput for detailed input/composition events.

Do not:
- Do not treat this as an autocomplete or results popup.
- Do not switch between controlled and uncontrolled ownership during the control's lifetime.

Example, Search orders:
```tsx
<SearchInput label="Search orders" defaultValue="BTC" />
```

### SegmentedControl

A compact single-selection control with native radio submission and bounded overflow.

Category: forms

Props:
- `id: string` (optional). Root fieldset ID used to derive stable relationships.
- `ref: HTMLFieldSetElement|((element:HTMLFieldSetElement)=>void)` (optional). Native root fieldset reference.
- `name: string` (required). Required nonempty native radio-group name.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible group legend.
- `options: readonly SegmentedControlOption[]` (required). Ordered unique values with nonempty labels and optional disabled state.
- `value: string|null` (optional). App-owned selection, or null for no selection.
- `defaultValue: string|null` (optional). Captured uncontrolled selection restored on uncanceled form reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:string|null)=>void` (optional). Receives requested committed selection changes.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting instructions associated with the group.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated error and invalid state.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Keeps the group focusable and submitted while rejecting changes.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires one enabled selection for native validation.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Visual and keyboard orientation.
- `size: "sm"|"md"` (optional; default "sm"). Compact or standard segment height.
- `overflowBehavior: "scroll"|"wrap"` (optional; default "scroll"). Scrolls one line by default or wraps when the app permits height growth.
- `fullWidth: boolean` (optional; default false). Stretch segments to share the container width equally, for short exclusive choices such as Buy/Sell.

Accessibility role: radiogroup and native radio
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow keys, Home, End, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-accent-subtle`, `--sheen-color-accent-fg`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use for a short set of mutually exclusive peer views or modes.

Do not:
- Do not use segments for independent toggles or a long searchable taxonomy.

Example, Report period:
```tsx
<SegmentedControl label="Report period" name="period" options={[{ value: "day", label: "Day" }, { value: "week", label: "Week" }, { value: "month", label: "Month" }]} defaultValue="week" />
```

### Select

A single choice with a scope-aware listbox and native form participation.

Category: forms

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `options: readonly SelectOption[]` (required). Options keyed by unique nonempty strings, with labels, descriptions, and disabled flags.
- `value: string|null` (optional). App-owned value; null explicitly clears selection.
- `defaultValue: string|null` (optional). Captured uncontrolled default restored by uncanceled form reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:string|null)=>void` (optional). Requested value changes; controlled owners may accept or reject.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form field name; unnamed selects do not submit.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form ID, associated with the trigger and native select.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Empty-selection text, defaulting to the localized selectOption message.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting instructions associated with the trigger.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated error text and invalid state, without automatic announcements.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents interaction and submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Allows inspection but rejects selection changes.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires a nonempty selection for native form submission.

Accessibility role: button
Keyboard: Tab, Space, Enter, Arrow keys, Home, End, Escape, Typeahead
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep option values stable across refreshes.

Do not:
- Do not use Select as an editable autocomplete.

Example, Refresh cadence:
```tsx
<Select label="Cadence" name="cadence" options={[{ value: "live", label: "Live" }, { value: "manual", label: "Manual" }]} defaultValue="live" />
```

A structural divider with native separator semantics and an explicit decorative mode.

Category: surfaces

Props:
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal or vertical separation. Vertical separators stretch within a constrained flex or grid row.
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default false). Hide a purely visual divider from assistive technology.

Accessibility role: separator unless decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

### Sheet

Provides the Drawer contract under the common Sheet name for task and detail panels.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `side: DrawerSide` (optional; default "end"). Logical viewport edge from which the panel enters.
- `title: string` (required). Accessible panel title.
- `contentId: string` (optional). Optional stable content element ID.
- `trigger: string` (optional). Visible label for the opening button.
- `description: string` (optional). Optional explanatory text associated with the panel.
- `open: boolean` (optional). Controlled open state.
- `defaultOpen: boolean` (optional; default false). Uncontrolled initial open state.
- `onOpenChange: ((open:boolean)=>void)` (optional). Requests an open-state change.
- `dismissible: boolean` (optional; default true). Allows Escape, outside press, and the close action.
- `closeLabel: string` (optional). Labelled footer close action. Without it, a corner close icon (named by the scoped close message) comes last in tab order; with it, or for alert dialogs, a labelled close action leads the footer.
- `initialFocus: (()=>HTMLElement)` (optional). Resolves an enabled focus target inside the panel.
- `returnFocus: (()=>HTMLElement)` (optional). Resolves a surviving focus target after close.
- `shortcutScope: string` (optional). Unique modal shortcut scope ID.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional classes on panel content.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). App-owned footer actions beside close.

Accessibility role: dialog
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-bg-overlay`, `--sheen-elevation-modal`, `--sheen-duration-slow`

Do:
- Use Sheet for the same modal side-panel behavior when that name fits the product vocabulary.

Do not:
- Do not use it for persistent AppShell navigation.

Example, Task sheet:
```tsx
<Sheet title="Task details" trigger="Open task"><Text>Current task</Text></Sheet>
```

### ShortcutPending

Persistent single-line live status for pending shortcut sequences.

Category: application

Props:
- `label: string` (optional). Accessible status name, defaulting to the scoped pendingShortcut message.

Accessibility role: status
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-control-h-sm`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-text-ui-size`

Do:
- Mount one instance in a persistent status or toolbar slot inside both providers.
- Keep its inline size constrained by the surrounding layout.

Do not:
- Do not conditionally mount the live region only after a prefix.
- Do not rely on one-second feedback as the only way to discover actions; retain the shortcut sheet.

Example, Sequence feedback:
```tsx
<ShortcutProvider platform="other" development={true}><ShortcutPending /></ShortcutProvider>
```

### ShortcutProvider

Owner-scoped chord and sequence dispatcher with usePendingShortcut feedback.

Category: application

Props:
- `children: JSX.Element` (optional). Owned application content; one provider per document, no nested providers.
- `platform: "mac"|"other"` (optional). Optional mac/other override, read at construction. When omitted, resolve navigator.platform on mount before registering bindings. SSR and initial hydration expose an empty inventory, never provisional wrong-platform bindings.
- `development: boolean` (required). Required collision policy, read at construction: development throws, production warns and uses last registration.
- `activeScopes: readonly string[]` (optional). Reactive outer-to-inner base scope IDs; default global. Focused ShortcutScope boundaries append outer-to-inner scopes. Open sheen dialogs override both with the newest active modal scope. Changes cancel pending sequences; non-sheen overlays must still manage their own isolation.
- `characterShortcuts: boolean` (optional). Allow character-only single keys and sequences, default true. Wire to a user-facing preference. False retains bindings requiring Ctrl, Meta, Alt, or a non-character key. Changes cancel pending input; the app owns persistence.
- `onError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Reports synchronous failures and async rejections while their registration is alive. Matched defaults are prevented before execution. Disposed registrations consume late rejections without notifying a new owner. Without a handler, live errors are rethrown in a microtask.

Accessibility role: none
Keyboard: Registered chords

Do:
- Use useShortcut inside an owned child component.
- Keep platform and development configuration stable for the provider lifetime.

Do not:
- Do not infer backend or modal state from this provider.
- Do not register reserved browser shortcuts or assume disposal cancels application transport.

Example, Keyboard owner:
```tsx
<ShortcutProvider development={true}><p>Workspace</p></ShortcutProvider>
```

### ShortcutScope

DOM-bound view or pane scope activated by keyboard focus in its descendants.

Category: application

Props:
- `scope: string` (required). Required unique non-global ID matching useShortcut registrations. Changes release the old scope and cancel pending input.

Accessibility role: none by default
Keyboard: Descendant keyboard events activate the innermost scope

Do:
- Use distinct IDs for simultaneously mounted panes/views.
- Place controls inside the native scope boundary; it adds no tab stop or layout styling.

Do not:
- Do not assume portalled children retain DOM focus ancestry.
- Do not use global as a scoped ID; open dialogs suspend focus scopes.

Example, Inspector pane:
```tsx
<ShortcutProvider development={true}><ShortcutScope scope="inspector"><Button>Inspect</Button></ShortcutScope></ShortcutProvider>
```

### ShortcutSheet

Generated modal inventory of registered shortcuts, grouped by their application labels.

Category: application

Props:
- `title: string` (required). Accessible dialog title.
- `contentId: string` (optional). Optional stable content element ID for an external aria-controls relationship. Must be unique in the document.
- `trigger: string` (optional). Visible label for the opening button.
- `description: string` (optional). Optional explanatory text associated with the dialog.
- `open: boolean` (optional). Controlled open state; rejected close requests retain the modal.
- `defaultOpen: boolean` (optional; default false). Uncontrolled initial open state; portal content mounts when the theme target is ready.
- `onOpenChange: ((open:boolean)=>void)` (optional). Requests a change in open state without mutating controlled ownership.
- `dismissible: boolean` (optional; default true). Allows Escape, outside press, and the close action; false disables all three.
- `closeLabel: string` (optional). Labelled footer close action. Without it, a corner close icon (named by the scoped close message) comes last in tab order; with it, or for alert dialogs, a labelled close action leads the footer.
- `initialFocus: (()=>HTMLElement)` (optional). Resolves an enabled focus target inside the mounted dialog.
- `returnFocus: (()=>HTMLElement)` (optional). Optional surviving focus target after closing, useful for triggerless dialogs.
- `shortcutScope: string` (optional). Unique modal shortcut scope ID, defaulting to an internal stable ID. Within ShortcutProvider, opening suspends outer scopes automatically. Register modal actions under this ID; do not reuse an application/global scope.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional classes on modal content.
- `footer: JSX.Element` (optional). App-owned footer actions beside the built-in close action.

Accessibility role: dialog
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-sm`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Mount inside ThemeProvider and ShortcutProvider.
- Provide a visible trigger even when question-mark opening is enabled.
- Let Dialog suspend outer scopes; use a unique shortcutScope for any sheet-specific bindings.

Do not:
- Do not assume this inventory implies every scope is active.
- Do not treat displayed shortcuts as the only means of executing an action.

Example, Discoverable keyboard help:
```tsx
<ShortcutProvider platform="other" development={true}><ShortcutSheet title="Keyboard shortcuts" trigger="Keyboard shortcuts" /></ShortcutProvider>
```

### Skeleton

A static decorative placeholder for a region's genuine first load.

Category: loading

Props:
- `shape: "text"|"rectangle"|"circle"` (optional; default "text"). Text line, rectangular region, or circular placeholder. Supply logical dimensions through style for the expected content geometry.

Accessibility role: decorative, hidden and inert
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-subtle`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-control-radius`, `--sheen-surface-radius`, `--sheen-text-ui-leading`, `--sheen-control-h-lg`

Do:
- Reserve the geometry of the expected content. The app owns the 200ms cold-load delay and a localized loading status for the region.

Do not:
- Do not replace loaded content during refresh or navigation with a skeleton.
- Do not put controls or meaningful content inside a skeleton. It is hidden from assistive technology and inert.
- Do not add shimmer, pulse, or mount animation.

Example, Cold-load placeholder:
```tsx
<Skeleton shape="rectangle" style={{ "block-size": "var(--sheen-control-h-lg)" }} />
```

### Slider

A single-value accessible slider with scoped locale formatting and native range input semantics.

Category: forms

Props:
- `value: number` (optional). Controlled finite value within the configured range.
- `defaultValue: number` (optional). Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to min.
- `onValueChange: (value:number)=>void` (optional). Receives each accepted pointer or keyboard value.
- `onValueChangeEnd: (value:number)=>void` (optional). Receives the accepted value at interaction end.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `min: number` (optional; default 0). Finite inclusive lower bound.
- `max: number` (optional; default 100). Finite inclusive upper bound.
- `step: number` (optional; default 1). Positive finite increment.
- `formatOptions: Intl.NumberFormatOptions` (optional). Intl number options evaluated with the effective scoped locale.
- `name: string` (optional). Native range-input form name.
- `form: string` (optional). ID of a form outside the component ancestry.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with the thumb.
- `error: string` (optional). Validation text that marks the slider invalid.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables pointer, keyboard, and form interaction.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents changes while retaining focus.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks the native range input required.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal or vertical physical orientation.
- `inverted: boolean` (optional; default false). Reverses the physical direction without changing numeric order.

Accessibility role: slider
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use a NumberField when exact entry matters more than spatial adjustment.

Do not:
- Do not use a slider for an unbounded or highly precise value.

Example, Percent threshold:
```tsx
<Slider label="Alert threshold" defaultValue={0.75} formatOptions={{ style: "percent", maximumFractionDigits: 0 }} min={0} max={1} step={0.05} />
```

### SortableList

A controlled reorderable list with pointer dragging, an accent drop indicator, auto-scroll, and an announced keyboard model. Import it from @gemologic/sheen/sortable with @gemologic/sheen/styles/sortable.css.

Category: data

Props:
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Root element reference.
- `items: readonly Item[]` (required). Owner-ordered items with stable, unique, nonempty ids and a label used for handles and announcements. Item nodes are keyed by id, so refreshed objects keep their DOM, focus, and any in-progress keyboard lift.
- `children: (item:Accessor<Item>,index:Accessor<number>)=>JSX.Element` (required). Renders one item from its accessor and current index. It runs once per id; read the accessor for refreshed data.
- `onReorder: (reorder:SortableReorder)=>void` (required). Receives { id, fromIndex, toIndex, ids } after a pointer drop or keyboard drop. The list is controlled: pass reordered items back to accept the move.
- `label: string` (required). Accessible name of the list.
- `orientation: SortableOrientation` (optional; default "vertical"). Layout and arrow-key axis. Horizontal arrows follow reading direction, so they mirror in RTL scopes.
- `handle: boolean` (optional; default false). Render a grip button on each item that owns pointer and keyboard dragging. Without it the whole item drags and is the keyboard target.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents picking up any item. Items with disabled: true cannot be picked up, but others still move around them.
- `messages: Partial<Readonly<Record<"sortableInstructions"|"sortableHandle"|"sortableLifted"|"sortableMoved"|"sortableDropped"|"sortableCancelled"|"boardInstructions"|"boardCardHandle"|"boardColumnHandle"|"boardLifted"|"boardMoved"|"boardDropped"|"boardCancelled"|"boardEmptyColumn"|"boardCardCount",string>>>` (optional). Per-instance overrides for the sortable* message keys. Scoped ThemeProvider messages with the same keys apply first.

Accessibility role: list of list items; each item (or its grip button) is the keyboard drag target, described by visually hidden instructions, with an assertive status region for announcements
Keyboard: Space or Enter picks up the focused item, ArrowUp/ArrowDown (vertical) or ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (horizontal, mirrored in RTL) move the lifted item, Home and End move it to the start or end, Space or Enter drops and calls onReorder, Escape or moving focus away cancels and restores the original position
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`, `--sheen-elevation-overlay`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`, `--sheen-surface-radius`

Do:
- Use stable ids from your data so DOM identity, focus, and drafts survive refreshes.
- Apply the proposed ids in onReorder, or keep the old order to reject the move.
- Use handle when items contain their own interactive controls.

Do not:
- Do not key items by index or regenerate ids on refresh.
- Do not use reordering as the only way to express priority when a numeric field is clearer.
- Do not import the drag engine directly; Sheen keeps it behind this entry.

Example, Reorderable tasks:
```tsx
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";
const [tasks, setTasks] = createSignal([{ id: "a", label: "Draft notes" }, { id: "b", label: "Rotate keys" }]);
<SortableList label="Tasks" items={tasks()} onReorder={event => setTasks(current => event.ids.flatMap(id => current.filter(task => task.id === id)))}>{task => <span>{task().label}</span>}</SortableList>
```

Example, Horizontal with handles:
```tsx
<SortableList label="Priorities" orientation="horizontal" handle items={[{ id: "p1", label: "Speed" }, { id: "p2", label: "Cost" }]} onReorder={() => {}}>{item => item().label}</SortableList>
```

### Spacer

Decorative flexible space in a Row or Stack; use gap for fixed spacing.

Category: layout

Props:

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not put content or interactive children inside Spacer.

Example, Spacer composition:
```tsx
<Row><Button>Back</Button><Spacer /><Button>Next</Button></Row>
```

### Spinner

A compact loading status with localized text and an optional decorative presentation.

Category: loading

Props:
- `size: "sm"|"md"|"lg"` (optional; default "md"). Semantic icon size.
- `label: string` (optional). Localized status text, defaulting to the provider's loading message.
- `decorative: boolean` (optional; default false). Hide the spinner when surrounding content already announces loading.

Accessibility role: status unless decorative
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-icon-size-sm`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`, `--sheen-icon-size-lg`, `--sheen-duration-slow`

Do:
- Use a compact status inside the affected region. The app owns loading timing.
- Use decorative mode beside an existing loading announcement to avoid duplicates.

Do not:
- Do not use full-page spinners or replace existing content during refresh.
- Do not rely on an initially server-rendered live region being announced automatically.

Example, Saving status:
```tsx
<Spinner label="Saving changes" />
```

### Stack

Vertical flow with density-aware block spacing.

Category: layout

Props:
- `gap: Spacing` (optional; default "md"). Role-based spacing that follows the active density.
- `align: Alignment` (optional; default "stretch"). Cross-axis alignment without changing DOM or keyboard order.
- `justify: Justification` (optional; default "start"). Main-axis distribution without reversing content order.

Accessibility role: presentation layout
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-space-block-md`, `--sheen-space-inline-md`

Do:
- Preserve logical DOM order and use token spacing.

Do not:
- Do not use layout wrappers to invent inaccessible keyboard order.

Example, Stack composition:
```tsx
<Stack><Input label="Name" /><Button>Save</Button></Stack>
```

### Stepper

A responsive workflow progress list with native link, action, and status steps.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `ref: HTMLElement|((element:HTMLElement)=>void)` (optional). Native navigation landmark reference.
- `label: string` (required). Required navigation and progress name.
- `steps: readonly StepperStep[]` (required). Stable-ID status, native-link, or native-button steps with one optional current step.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Horizontal flow that stacks responsively, or an always-vertical flow.
- `density: "compact"|"default"` (optional; default "default"). Default or compact spacing.
- `refreshing: boolean` (optional; default false). Marks retained accepted steps busy without replacing them.

Accessibility role: navigation, progressbar, and ordered list
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-accent-subtle`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`, `--sheen-color-danger-subtle`

Do:
- Use link steps for URL changes and action steps only for in-place operations.

Do not:
- Do not encode progress only through connector or marker color.

Example, Workspace setup:
```tsx
<Stepper label="Workspace setup" steps={[{ kind: "status", id: "account", label: "Account", state: "completed" }, { kind: "link", id: "team", label: "Team", state: "current", href: "/setup/team" }, { kind: "status", id: "finish", label: "Finish", state: "upcoming" }]} />
```

### StreamingText

Plain text that grows token by token, retaining paragraph nodes and announcing completion once.

Category: ai

Props:
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Native root reference.
- `text: string` (required). The full accepted text so far. Blank lines separate paragraphs; other whitespace is preserved. Not parsed as markdown or HTML.
- `streaming: boolean` (optional; default false). Shows the caret and marks the text busy. Changing it from true to false announces completion politely.
- `completeLabel: string` (optional). Completion announcement; defaults to the scoped responseComplete message.

Accessibility role: text with a polite status announcement
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-duration-slow`, `--sheen-space-block-md`

Do:
- Publish the accumulated text, not individual tokens; appends rewrite only the final paragraph.

Do not:
- Do not render model output as HTML.
- Do not toggle streaming per token; that would announce repeatedly.

Example, Streaming reply:
```tsx
<StreamingText text={"Checking the deploy log\n\nThe billing worker"} streaming />
```

### Surface

Semantic surface with role padding and an inherited focus-ring offset.

Category: surfaces

Props:
- `variant: "base"|"subtle"|"raised"|"inset"` (optional; default "base"). Semantic surface fill; also establishes the focus-ring offset for descendants.
- `padding: Spacing` (optional; default "none"). Role-based padding; none leaves spacing to the composition.
- `bordered: boolean` (optional; default false). Adds a structural border, not an interactive-control boundary.
- `elevated: boolean` (optional; default false). Opt-in raised shadow. Keep elevation sparse.

Accessibility role: generic surface
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring-offset`

Do:
- Use role tokens and preserve the surrounding keyboard order.

Do not:
- Do not add structural borders or shadows merely as decoration.

Example, Surface composition:
```tsx
<Surface variant="raised" padding="md"><Input label="Name" /></Surface>
```

### Switch

A labeled binary setting with native form participation and switch semantics.

Category: forms

Props:
- `description: string` (optional). Associated supporting instructions.
- `id: string` (optional). Root container ID used to derive internal IDs.
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Root container reference; inputRef targets the native input.
- `onPointerDown: NonNullable<JSX.EventHandlerUnion<HTMLDivElement,PointerEvent,JSX.EventHandler<HTMLDivElement,PointerEvent>>>` (optional). Native root pointer-down handler composed with focus behavior.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label, unchanged between on and off.
- `error: string` (optional). Associated error marking the control invalid without moving focus.
- `checked: boolean` (optional). App-owned state, retained on reset unless the app changes it.
- `defaultChecked: boolean` (optional; default false). Initial uncontrolled state restored on uncanceled reset.
- `onCheckedChange: ((checked:boolean)=>void)` (optional). Receives the requested boolean state, not a DOM event.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents changes, keyboard focus, and form submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Prevents changes while retaining focus and submission.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires the switch to be on for native form validation.
- `name: string` (optional). Native form name; empty or omitted names are not submitted.
- `form: string` (optional). External owning form ID, forwarded to the native input.
- `value: string` (optional; default "on"). Value submitted when on.
- `inputRef: ((element:HTMLInputElement)=>void)` (optional). Receives the native input.

Accessibility role: switch
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-icon-size-md`

Do:
- Use a stable label describing the setting, not its current value.

Do not:
- Do not use mixed state; a switch is strictly on or off.

Example, Live updates:
```tsx
<Switch label="Live updates" defaultChecked description="Refresh this view automatically." />
```

### Table

Native table semantics and token styling for bounded, non-virtualized tables.

Category: data-display

Props:
- `striped: boolean` (optional; default false). Alternate body-row surfaces with matching focus offsets.

Accessibility role: native table
Keyboard: Native controls within cells retain their tab order; static rows are not focus stops.
Tokens: `--sheen-table-row-h`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-bg-subtle`

Do:
- Supply a caption or explicit accessible table name. Use header cells with scope=col or scope=row.
- Keep native table nesting and explicit TableBody for deterministic server markup.

Do not:
- Do not use this primitive for unbounded datasets. DataTable owns virtualization, pagination, and grid interaction.
- Do not make static rows keyboard focus stops or apply grid roles without implementing grid behavior.

Example, Small order table:
```tsx
<Table><TableCaption>Orders</TableCaption><TableHead><TableRow><TableHeaderCell>Symbol</TableHeaderCell><TableHeaderCell numeric>Quantity</TableHeaderCell></TableRow></TableHead><TableBody><TableRow><TableHeaderCell scope="row">BTC</TableHeaderCell><TableCell numeric>1.25</TableCell></TableRow></TableBody></Table>
```

### Tabs

Named tab panels with stable identities, retained drafts, and scoped keyboard navigation.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the tab list.
- `items: readonly TabOption[]` (required). Ordered tabs with stable unique values, labels, and optional disabled state.
- `value: string` (optional). Controlled selected value.
- `defaultValue: string` (optional). Initial uncontrolled value; defaults to the first enabled tab.
- `onValueChange: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Requests selection; controlled owners may reject it.
- `orientation: "horizontal"|"vertical"` (optional; default "horizontal"). Tab list layout and arrow-key axis.
- `activationMode: "automatic"|"manual"` (optional; default "automatic"). Automatic selects on arrow navigation; manual requires Enter or Space.
- `children: (value:string)=>JSX.Element` (required). Panel renderer, mounted once per stable item value and retained while inactive.

Accessibility role: tablist, tab, tabpanel
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-border`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Keep values stable during refresh.
- Use manual activation when selection starts expensive work.

Do not:
- Do not use tabs as a substitute for URL navigation.
- Do not assume inactive panels stop effects or native form submission.

Example, Settings panels:
```tsx
<Tabs label="Settings" items={[{ value: "general", label: "General" }, { value: "advanced", label: "Advanced" }]}>{value => <Input label={`${value} name`} />}</Tabs>
```

### Tag

A labeled chip with optional native-button removal; collection state remains app-owned.

Category: data display

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Plain-text tag identity, also used by the default accessible remove label.
- `onRemove: ()=>void` (optional). App-owned removal callback. The app updates the collection and restores focus if the tag disappears.
- `removeLabel: string` (optional). Override the accessible remove-button name; defaults to the localized remove message plus label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables removal without hiding the tag.
- `tone: StatusTone` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic status or market role, independent of the selected accent.
- `variant: "soft"|"solid"|"outline"` (optional; default "soft"). Soft fill, solid fill, or outline treatment.
- `size: "sm"|"md"` (optional; default "sm"). Density-aware label size.

Accessibility role: label with optional removal button
Keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-text-caption-size`, `--sheen-color-success-fg`, `--sheen-color-success-subtle`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not remove a focused tag without moving focus to a surviving control.

Example, Tag example:
```tsx
<Tag label="In review" tone="info" />
```

### TagInput

An ordered free-form tag editor with native multi-value submission and stale-safe async validation.

Category: forms

Props:
- `ref: HTMLDivElement|((element:HTMLDivElement)=>void)` (optional). Native root reference.
- `inputRef: HTMLInputElement|((element:HTMLInputElement)=>void)` (optional). Native editable-input reference.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible field label.
- `name: string` (optional). Native multi-value form name.
- `form: string` (optional). Optional external form ID.
- `value: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled ordered unique nonempty tag values.
- `defaultValue: readonly string[]` (optional). Initial uncontrolled values restored on uncanceled form reset.
- `onValueChange: (value:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives ordered committed tag values.
- `validate: (candidate:string,context:TagInputValidationContext,signal:AbortSignal)=>TagInputValidationResult|Promise<TagInputValidationResult>` (optional). Optional sync or async candidate validator. It receives accepted values and an AbortSignal; stale completions cannot publish.
- `onValidationError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Receives unexpected validator failures after the retained draft receives a localized error.
- `normalize: (draft:string)=>string` (optional). Synchronous candidate normalization before uniqueness and validation; defaults to trim.
- `placeholder: string` (optional). Editable-input placeholder shown only when no tags exist.
- `description: string` (optional). Supporting text associated with the editor.
- `error: string` (optional). App-owned field error, distinct from candidate validation.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Disables editing, removal, reordering, validation, and form submission.
- `readOnly: boolean` (optional; default false). Keeps values and controls inspectable while rejecting changes.
- `required: boolean` (optional; default false). Requires at least one committed tag in the native form projection.
- `commitKeys: readonly string[]` (optional). Keys that validate and commit the current draft; defaults to Enter and comma.

Accessibility role: labeled text input and native multi-select projection
Keyboard: Enter, Comma, Backspace, Delete, Alt+Arrow keys, Alt+Home, Alt+End
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-color-neutral-subtle`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`

Do:
- Use stable exact strings when order and free-form entry both matter.

Do not:
- Do not use TagInput for selection from a controlled taxonomy; use MultiCombobox.

Example, Project labels:
```tsx
<TagInput label="Labels" name="labels" defaultValue={["frontend", "urgent"]} description="Press Enter to add a label." />
```

### Text

Inline text with semantic type roles, accessible muted color, and optional tabular figures.

Category: typography

Props:
- `size: "caption"|"ui-sm"|"ui"|"body"|"lead"` (optional; default "ui"). Semantic type role, not an arbitrary font size.
- `tone: "default"|"muted"` (optional; default "default"). Primary or AA-gated muted foreground.
- `numeric: boolean` (optional; default false). Enable tabular figures for aligned numeric content.

Accessibility role: inline text
Keyboard: native behavior
Tokens: `--sheen-font-sans`, `--sheen-font-mono`, `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-fg-muted`

Do:
- Use visible text as well as color to communicate meaning.

Do not:
- Do not use low-contrast subtle tokens for meaningful text.

Example, Text example:
```tsx
<Text tone="muted" size="caption">Updated recently</Text>
```

### Textarea

A labeled native multiline input with optional frame-batched autosizing.

Category: forms

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required visible label.
- `description: string` (optional). Instructions associated with the textarea.
- `error: string` (optional). App-owned validation message, associated with the invalid textarea.
- `autoResize: boolean` (optional; default false). Measure content after mount and grow or shrink on input, value, width, font, or theme changes. Owns inline block-size while enabled; use min/max-block-size constraints. Rows reserves initial server geometry.

Accessibility role: multiline textbox
Keyboard: Native multiline text editing, Enter inserts a newline, Tab follows native focus order
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-inset`, `--sheen-color-border-control`, `--sheen-text-ui-leading`, `--sheen-space-block-xs`

Do:
- Reserve realistic rows on the server. Font-dependent measurement happens after hydration without replacing the control.
- Use max-block-size to cap growth; excess content remains scrollable.

Do not:
- Do not autosubmit on Enter or discard drafts during background refresh.
- Do not animate height while typing or set a competing inline block-size during autosizing.

Example, Growing notes:
```tsx
<Textarea label="Notes" rows={3} autoResize description="Shared with the team." />
```

### ThemeProvider

Owns application theme state, scoped overlays, messages, and root-only persistence.

Category: theming

Props:
- `initialState: ThemeState` (optional). Deterministic initial state; cookie mode requires identical server/client state.
- `defaultMode: Mode|"system"` (optional; default "dark"). Fresh-install preference; system follows the OS only when explicitly selected.
- `defaultTheme: string` (optional; default "obsidian"). Default registered theme ID.
- `defaultAccent: string` (optional; default "jade"). Default independent accent preset.
- `defaultDensity: "compact"|"comfortable"|"spacious"` (optional; default "comfortable"). Default control density.
- `defaultRadius: "sharp"|"soft"|"round"` (optional; default "soft"). Default corner treatment.
- `defaultMotion: "full"|"reduced"` (optional; default "full"). Default motion preference; OS reduced motion still wins.
- `direction: "ltr"|"rtl"` (optional; default "ltr"). Explicit writing direction.
- `locale: string` (optional; default "en-US"). Explicit server/client Intl locale.
- `themes: readonly ThemeMetadata[]` (optional). Registered themes. Load their CSS and configure the same prepaint catalog.
- `accents: readonly string[]` (optional). Custom accent IDs built with defineAccent/buildAccent. Load their CSS and pass the same IDs to createThemeScript({ accents }).
- `storageKey: string` (optional; default "sheen"). Root preference storage key.
- `hydration: "client"|"cookie"` (optional; default "client"). Client prepaint handoff or cookie-authoritative SSR.
- `persist: (state:ThemeState)=>Promise<void>` (optional). Cookie-mode app callback, awaited before accepting preference changes.
- `onPersistenceError: (error:unknown)=>void` (optional). Reports failed storage or cookie persistence.
- `nonce: string` (optional). CSP nonce for generated scope scripts; match the document policy.
- `messages: Partial<Messages>` (optional). Partial translations inheriting English defaults.

Accessibility role: context provider
Keyboard: native behavior

Do:
- Install the theme prepaint script in client hydration mode.

Do not:
- Do not choose initial markup from browser-only state.

Example, Dark application root:
```tsx
<ThemeProvider defaultMode="dark" locale="en-US"><Button>Save</Button></ThemeProvider>
```

### ThemeScope

Overrides theme axes locally, with inherited messages and a contextual overlay target.

Category: theming

Props:
- `controllable: boolean` (optional; default false). Makes scoped setters modify local overrides only. Without it, setters forward axes the scope does not pin to the parent and reject pinned axes.
- `class: string` (optional). Class for the scope wrapper.
- `messages: Partial<Messages>` (optional). Partial translations layered over the parent scope's messages.
- `theme: string|null` (optional). Local theme ID; omitted inherits and null resets to provider default.
- `mode: Mode|"system"|null` (optional). Local mode; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `accent: string|null` (optional). Local accent preset; never changes root persistence.
- `density: "compact"|"comfortable"|"spacious"|null` (optional). Local density; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `radius: "sharp"|"soft"|"round"|null` (optional). Local corner treatment; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `motion: "full"|"reduced"|null` (optional). Local motion preference; OS reduced motion still wins.
- `direction: "ltr"|"rtl"|null` (optional). Local writing direction; omitted inherits and null resets.
- `locale: string|null` (optional). Local explicit formatting locale; omitted inherits and null resets.

Accessibility role: themed region
Keyboard: native behavior

Do:
- Use independent iframes for full-layout comparisons.

Do not:
- Do not expect scopes to persist preferences.

Example, Light comparison pane:
```tsx
<ThemeScope theme="paper" mode="light" accent="indigo"><Input label="Preview name" /></ThemeScope>
```

### Toast

A notification card with stable action, pending, retry, and dismissal controls.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `notification: ToastNotification` (required). Immutable controller snapshot. Raw errors are never rendered.
- `onAction: ()=>void` (required). Request the owning controller's action. Pending actions cannot be invoked through the button.
- `onDismiss: ()=>void` (required). Request removal without canceling app-owned work.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional card classes.

Accessibility role: group
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-color-danger-fg`, `--sheen-elevation-overlay`

Do:
- Key cards by notification handle and pass updated snapshots into the existing card.
- Provide safe localized action error text.

Do not:
- Do not use a transient card as the only place essential information or actions can be found.
- Do not mistake the card for a complete queue presenter: announcements, timers, and removal belong to the presenter.

Example, Notification card:
```tsx
const notices = createToaster(); const id = notices.show({ title: "Saved", duration: null }); const notification = notices.notifications()[0];
<>{notification && <Toast notification={notification} onAction={() => { void notices.runAction(id); }} onDismiss={() => { notices.dismiss(id); }} />}</>
```

### Toaster

A scoped, bounded notification queue with live announcements and paused visible-time expiry.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `controller: ToastController` (required). Owner-local notification controller. Mount one presenter for each controller.
- `limit: number` (optional; default 3). Positive maximum number of visible or exiting cards; queued cards do not consume lifetime.
- `label: string` (optional). Accessible region name; defaults to the scoped notifications message.
- `class: string` (optional). Additional region classes.

Accessibility role: region
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-duration-fast`, `--sheen-space-block-md`

Do:
- Create and mount a controller inside the appropriate theme scope.
- Keep essential information and actions available without a time limit.

Do not:
- Do not treat dismissal as cancellation of an app-owned request.
- Do not mount multiple presenters for the same controller.

Example, Scoped notifications:
```tsx
const notices = createToaster();
<><Button onClick={() => { notices.show({ title: "Saved", tone: "success" }); }}>Save</Button><Toaster controller={notices} /></>
```

### Tooltip

An action button with hover/focus help and optional shortcut display.

Category: overlays

Props:
- `type: "button"|"submit"|"reset"` (optional; default "button"). Native action, submission, or reset behavior.
- `content: string` (required). Noninteractive supporting text; never a replacement for the trigger's accessible name.
- `shortcut: string|ShortcutAction` (optional). A string displays a hint only; a typed shortcut action also registers the trigger and displays its platform-formatted binding.
- `placement: "top"|"bottom"|"left"|"right"` (optional; default "top"). Preferred side, with viewport collision handling.
- `openDelay: number` (optional; default 500). Hover opening delay in milliseconds; keyboard focus opens immediately.
- `closeDelay: number` (optional; default 100). Pointer departure delay in milliseconds, preserving a hoverable path to the content.
- `variant: NonNullable<"solid"|"soft"|"outline"|"ghost"|"link">` (optional; default "outline"). Visual treatment; solid accent actions should be rare.
- `tone: NonNullable<"neutral"|"accent"|"danger"|"success">` (optional; default "neutral"). Semantic color role, independent of visual treatment.
- `size: NonNullable<"xs"|"sm"|"md"|"lg">` (optional; default "md"). Density-aware control size.
- `loading: false|true` (optional; default false). Marks pending work and suppresses activation while keeping the button focusable.

Accessibility role: tooltip
Keyboard: Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-button-radius`, `--sheen-control-h-md`, `--sheen-color-accent`, `--sheen-color-bg-raised`, `--sheen-elevation-raised`, `--sheen-duration-fast`

Do:
- Provide a visible label or aria-label on the native trigger.

Do not:
- Do not nest a button inside Tooltip or put interactive controls in its content.

Example, Save hint:
```tsx
<Tooltip content="Save the workspace" shortcut={{ keys: "mod+s", scope: "global", label: "Save workspace", group: "Editing" }} variant="outline">Save</Tooltip>
```

### Tree

A hierarchical treeview with explicit selection, retained expansion state, roving focus, and typeahead.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `label: string` (required). Required accessible name for the tree.
- `selectionMode: TreeSelectionMode` (optional; default "single"). Whether items are unselectable, singly selected, or independently selected.
- `selectedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled stable item values selected by the app.
- `defaultSelectedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Initially selected values for uncontrolled operation.
- `onSelectionChange: (values:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives requested selection; controlled owners may reject it.
- `expandedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Controlled stable branch values that expose their child groups.
- `defaultExpandedValues: readonly string[]` (optional). Initially expanded branch values for uncontrolled operation.
- `onExpandedChange: (values:readonly string[])=>void` (optional). Receives requested expansion; controlled owners may reject it.
- `onActivate: (value:string)=>void` (optional). Handles Enter or the default item action without changing selection or focus.

Accessibility role: tree
Keyboard: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home, End, Enter, Space, *, typeahead
Tokens: `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-bg-selected`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Use stable unique values and preserve item ownership while labels or data refresh.
- Keep focus, selection, expansion, and activation as separate states.

Do not:
- Do not use Tree for a flat list or remount it to publish refreshed data.

Example, Workspace tree:
```tsx
<Tree label="Workspace" defaultExpandedValues={["src"]}><TreeItem value="src" label="Source"><TreeItem value="app" label="App" /></TreeItem><TreeItem value="readme" label="README" /></Tree>
```

### TreeItem

A stable leaf or retained branch within a Tree.

Category: navigation

Props:
- `value: string` (required). Required stable identity, unique within the owning tree.
- `label: string` (required). Required visible and accessible item label.
- `disabled: boolean` (optional; default false). Keeps the item focusable while preventing selection, activation, and expansion.
- `children: JSX.Element` (optional). Nested TreeItems; providing children makes this item an expandable branch.

Accessibility role: treeitem
Keyboard: ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Enter, Space
Tokens: `--sheen-color-fg`, `--sheen-color-bg-hover`, `--sheen-color-focus-ring`, `--sheen-space-inline-sm`

Do:
- Keep each value stable across background refresh and reordering.

Do not:
- Do not put unrelated interactive controls inside an item label.

Example, Retained branch:
```tsx
<Tree label="Files"><TreeItem value="src" label="Source"><TreeItem value="index" label="index.ts" /></TreeItem></Tree>
```
